source: HYPOTHESIS.md: Fixed before any run (Statistics), Confirmatory hypotheses (Common rules, H1-H8), D1, E2, E8, Plain answers; BUILD_SPEC.md section 5.8. Only H2 may change, by Amendment 0 at the sign-off (RUNBOOK step 6).

notes.units: Accuracy margins are fractions (-0.04 = -4 pp). H1 and H8 are ratios, H5 a ratio of bytes per token, D1 in GiB (2^30 bytes).
notes.H1: null: K4/G4 batch-1 decode ratio <= 0.75; t-test on the block log-ratios against ln 0.75
notes.H2: null: mean D <= H2; reverse null: mean D >= H2
notes.H3: null: D >= H3; reverse null: D <= H3_refute
notes.H4: null: D <= H4; reverse null: D >= H4_refute
notes.H5: null: either ratio <= H5; reverse null: both ratios >= H5 (Bonferroni over the two)
notes.H6: null: D >= H6; reverse null: D <= H6
notes.H7: null: mean (K4 - K8) <= H7; reverse null: mean >= H7
notes.H8: null: ratio >= H8; reverse null: ratio <= H8; CONFIRMED also needs the per-text ratio <= H8 on >= H8_texts_min of H8_texts_total texts
notes.D1: CONFIRMED if median peak(64k) <= D1_confirm_gib; REFUTED if > D1_refute_gib; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise
notes.H1_blocks_D1_reps: the pre-registered counts (H1: 10 blocks, df = 9; D1: 3 reps at 64k); another count is NOT RUN (review fix 2026-10-03)
notes.E8_flag: |local - vendor| > E8_flag for a peer on a row an H uses: H3 MMLU EN/DE, H4 IFBench, H6 RGB closed-book
notes.headline_peer_band: Q2 plain answer: peers' mean D on the shared rows within +/- this band
notes.H2_row_named_abs: H2_detail names every row with |D_r| > this
notes.H2_row_upper_named: the Q2 CONFIRMED sentence names any row whose 95 % upper bound is < this
notes.E2: says so: upper(dwrong) <= E2_dwrong_max and lower(A) >= E2_abstain_min; guesses: lower(dwrong) > E2_dwrong_max; knows less: upper(forced deficit) < E2_knows_less_upper
